'''2018 European MPC Results Cedrik Vanderhaegen DS Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Cedrik Vanderhaegen]] at [[2018 European Match Play Championship]] (Results).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Cedrik Vanderhaegen]]
* '''Event:''' [[2018 European Match Play Championship]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe|SE-D-huntdownanddestroythejedi.gif}}
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:Open HD Vanderhaegen DS 2018 MPC.txt |Download]]
* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Results
* '''Source:''' [https://www.starwarsccg.org/2018-european-match-play-championships/ PC list]
